   */static validateParams(params){const errors=[];if(!params.initialPosition||params.initialPosition<=0||params.initialPosition>100){errors.push('起始仓位必须在0-100%之间');}if(!params.multiplier||params.multiplier<=1||params.multiplier>10){errors.push('加仓倍率必须在1-10之间');}if(!params.maxLevels||params.maxLevels<=0||params.maxLevels>20){errors.push('最大加仓次数必须在1-20之间');}if(!params.priceStep||params.priceStep<=0||params.priceStep>50){errors.push('价格跌幅步长必须在0-50%之间');}if(!params.totalCapital||params.totalCapital<=0){errors.push('总本金必须大于0');}// 检查资金是否足够
